firstRun.title: Set up Harness Anything
firstRun.subtitle: Choose an existing git repository. Harness Anything will initialize its local ledger and connect it to the bundled daemon.
firstRun.addNpmScripts: Add Harness Anything npm scripts when package.json exists
firstRun.localOnly: Local only · no server or account required
firstRun.providerHint: Use the Provider workspace behind this guide to add a detected Claude, Codex, or AGY installation and select its model. You may continue without one.
firstRun.agentHint: Use the Agent workspace behind this guide to create an Agent declaration and bind its runtime preferences. You may finish and return later.
